name: AgentTestGenerationAgent
description: Uses Gemini to generate acceptance tests strictly from the BRD — agent-specific tests per requirement/acceptance criterion and general tests only for qualities the BRD states — discarding any test whose BRD quote cannot be verified.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: REQ-xx requirements (with source quotes) from BrdBuilderAgent

inputs.name: brd_markdown
inputs.description: Full BRD text — the only source of test content

inputs.name: agent_profile
inputs.description: Only its interface is used, to phrase inputs for how the agent is called

outputs.name: test_cases
outputs.description: TC-xxx tests with requirement_ref, acceptance_criterion, verified brd_reference, input, expected behaviour and pass criteria
